title: Connection error message reports the wrong command line when running from url
body:
# How to repro:
1. Run a script from url. For example:
```
streamlit run https://github.com/streamlit/demo-self-driving/blob/master/app.py
```
2. Interrupt the script and look at the UI
3. Wait until the Connection Error message shows up (30 sec or less)

# What should happens
The command line reported on the error message reflects the url we have run the script from

# What happens
We show the temporary file in the error message
